g.text: THE SUMMARY · WRITTEN FOR A CITIZEN

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: Mr. Patil gave the dealer a cheque for Rs. 4.5 lakh. The bank returned it because there was not enough money.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: The law on bounced cheques (Section 138, Negotiable Instruments Act) makes this a crime if he did not pay

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: within 15 days of a written demand. That demand letter is called a “legal notice”.

text.font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

g.text: THE SUMMARY · WRITTEN FOR A LAW STUDENT

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: A complaint under s.138 NI Act. With the signature admitted, s.139 presumes the cheque was for a debt;

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: the accused may rebut it on a preponderance of probabilities (Rangappa v. Sri Mohan, 2010).

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: The “security cheque” defence goes to that rebuttal, not to the elements of the offence.

text.font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

g.text: THE SUMMARY · WRITTEN FOR AN ADVOCATE

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: Issues: (i) a legally enforceable debt, or only security; (ii) service of the demand notice; (iii) limitation.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: Evidence to secure: return memo of 17.01.2025, postal tracking for 08.02.2025, ledger and delivery challans.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: The notice went to the address printed on the cheque, which the accused admits is his residence.

text.font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

g.text: THE SUMMARY · WRITTEN FOR A JUDGE

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: Complaint under s.138 NI Act. Dishonour (17.01.2025) and the demand notice (05.02.2025) are on record.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: Signature admitted. Non-receipt of notice is pleaded, though the address on the cheque is admitted.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: The burden lies on the accused to rebut the presumption under s.139.

text.font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

g.text: THE SUMMARY · WRITTEN FOR A RESEARCHER

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: Statute: NI Act ss.118, 138, 139 and 142. Elements, presumptions, notice and limitation set out in order,

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: with the leading authority (Rangappa v. Sri Mohan, 2010) and the points to check against the record.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

g.text: Every section cited is listed with the Act it comes from.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Nirmala UI', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

svg.text: One cheque-bounce case, five readers: the agents change depth and tone, never the facts · output in English, Hindi or Marathi
